summary: Strengthen process safety controls, MOC reviews and indicator reporting. Explore the five-day course and practical workplace exercises.
lede: Process safety leadership helps managers and HSE leaders connect hazard findings with ownership of safety-critical controls. For process safety, HSE, plant and operations managers, the training supports decisions to reduce major-accident exposure by turning risk reviews into clear actions. Participants practise prioritizing HAZOP and LOPA findings, reviewing management of change and permit-to-work interfaces, and tracking control performance through indicators and incident learning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, verify or oversee decisions affecting process hazards, safety-critical controls and major-accident prevention.
modules: CCPS Risk Based Process Safety Leadership
Process Safety Leadership Review and Action
prerequisites: Prior experience in operations, maintenance, engineering, HSE or process safety is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you wish to complete the spreadsheet-based indicator exercise; plant-specific data is optional.
